name: Spelhubben Weather
author: Kenta Mattsson

sections.description:
This plugin displays current weather and an optional forecast. It can aggregate data from northern-Europe friendly providers (Open-Meteo, SMHI, and Yr/MET Norway) and compute a simple consensus.

Features
– Gutenberg block and shortcode
– Optional Leaflet map (OpenStreetMap)
– Daily forecast and multiple layouts (inline, compact, card, detailed)
– Caching with transients
– Fully translatable

Not affiliated with Open-Meteo, SMHI, Yr/MET Norway, Leaflet, or OpenStreetMap. Names are used for descriptive purposes only. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
sections.installation:
1. Upload/activate the plugin.
  2. Add the “Spelhubben Weather” block or use the [spelhubben_weather] shortcode.
sections.faq:
Where does the data come from?

From public APIs such as Open-Meteo, SMHI and Yr/MET Norway (depending on your settings).

Do I need an API key?

No, but for Yr/MET Norway it’s recommended to include contact info (email/URL) in the settings (User-Agent).

short_description: Lightweight weather widget/block with optional multi-provider consensus (Open-Meteo, SMHI, Yr/MET Norway). Shortcode + block + classic widget.
